title: elsota calophylla
intro: Elsota calophylla, commonly known as Elsota, is a type of plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, aiding in the relief of pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Elsota calophylla include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
